# laconicleon

> The personal writing and project site of Leon Reed, also writing as 简练. The site publishes bilingual essays, practical browser-tool guides, and selected independent projects.

Last updated: 2026-09-01

## Core pages

- [Home](https://laconicleon.com/): Leon Reed / 简练 — writing and independent work.
- [Writing](https://laconicleon.com/writing/): bilingual writing archive.
- [Projects](https://laconicleon.com/projects/): selected independent projects and public product profiles.
- [About](https://laconicleon.com/about/): biography, interests, and creative principles.
- [Now](https://laconicleon.com/now/): current focus and recent work.
